gas-moon.description: Continual core deformation generates tremendous internal heat.
Extreme gravity anomalies due to an asymmetrical planet core.
Orbit passes through a ring of superheated plasma shed by a neighbor moon.
Gravitational pulling from nearby giants creates massive internal friction.
Caught inside a planetary ring; bombarded by house-sized ice/rock.
Gas is compressed so tightly it acts like a dissolving liquid.
Constant gravitational tugging grinds underground rock into shifting gravel.
Gravitational flexing liquefies the planet’s mantle continuously.
Proximity to a gas giant pulls oceans/crust up by tens of meters daily.
Co-orbiting with thousands of lethal asteroids.
Trapped inside a gas giant’s lethal radiation belt.
The moon constantly drops in and out of the giant's magnetic tail; triggering massive surface voltage arcs and grid failures.
Tidal forces tear open supersonic vents; shooting toxic ice crystals into orbit that rain back down as ballistic shrapnel.
Orbital resonance periodicities cause dramatic surges in tidal friction; melting the lower crust and driving sudden global volcanic upheaval.
The gas giant frequently blots out the sun for days; plunging the moon into deep cryogenic freezes that exhaust power reserves.
A multi-million ampere electrical current connects the moon to the giant; vaporizing machinery caught in the moving footprint.
Extreme tidal pulling prevents internal layers from settling cleanly; causing sudden, catastrophic mass shifts deep within the mantle.
The giant's magnetic field acts as a funnel; steering hyper-velocity ring dust directly into the moon's forward-facing hemisphere.
Solar radiation interacting with captured planetary gases creates a thick, opaque haze; blinding sensors and coating solar arrays in soot.
Proximity to the gas giant's upper atmosphere creates subtle drag; slowly warping structures and causing persistent orbital decay for satellites.
The rigid crust violently slips against the tidal bulge of the fluid mantle beneath; triggering planet-wide, magnitude-10 faults.

hot.description: Descending air currents compress and superheat low-lying valleys.
Surface is covered deep in unstable, highly abrasive volcanic ash.
Entire planet crust periodically sinks into the mantle and melts.
High temperatures cause iron vapor to condense and fall as molten liquid.
Surface features seas of molten basalt and granite.
Low-viscosity lava floods thousands of square kilometers daily.
Air permanently carries superheated ash particles from ongoing eruptions.
Liquid falls at temperatures hot enough to melt human skin instantly.
Standard magma eruptions but on a hyper-frequent, planetary scale.
Surface heat turns most fluids instantly into a bursting gas.
Sudden downdrafts of superheated air that crush structures.
Volcanic craters prone to massive, explosive collapse.
Extreme ambient heat bakes surface limestone and carbonates; continuously outgassing toxic carbon dioxide directly from the bedrock.
Massive thermal differentials drive permanent, towering storm walls that unleash supersonic winds and continuous, high-voltage lightning grids.
Intense solar heating expands the upper crust faster than the deep interior; causing the ground to violently warp, fracture, and heave upward.
The upper atmosphere is so hot that water vapor rises unchecked to the exosphere; where solar radiation permanently splits and strips away the hydrogen.
Any liquid water introduced by industry or habitats triggers an explosive exothermic reaction with superheated, unweathered basalt minerals.
Dried-up ancient seas leave vast plains of caustic, superheated sodium and potassium salts; whipped by winds into skin-stripping chemical storms.
A dense layer of superheated gas locks near the surface; trapping toxic industrial pollutants and heat with zero vertical atmospheric mixing.
Atmospheric heat dynamics cause the entire sky to rotate much faster than the planet itself; driving ceaseless, crushing high-altitude wind shear.
Persistent, high ambient temperatures cause structural metals and engineering foundations to slowly stretch and warp under their own weight.
The sun-baked crust reaches the threshold where subsurface volcanic minerals dehydrate; violently releasing trapped pockets of scalding steam.

star-near.description: Star is actively blowing the planet's mass into space.
Continual core deformation generates tremendous internal heat.
Surface minerals are highly altered by long-term ion bombardment.
Skims the upper corona of its star at periastron.
Extreme proximity to star melts the dayside crust.
Gravitational flexing liquefies the planet’s mantle continuously.
Star puts out extreme UV-C; organics instantly mutate or shatter.
Whole continents melt into gas when the orbital path nears the star.
Vaporized rock in the atmosphere condenses and falls back to the surface as searing, molten glass droplets.
Intense photoionization charges the desert surface; lifting clouds of microscopic, jagged regolith that foil solar arrays and mechanical joints.
The planet's movement through the star's immense magnetic field induces massive electrical currents in the iron-rich bedrock; superheating the terrain.
On tidally locked worlds, the border between day and night shifts back and forth; creating persistent, supersonic thermal winds that shred surface structures.
Extreme stellar radiation splits underground water or hydroxyl molecules at the atomic level; leaving the planet completely dry and stripped of hydrogen.
All lighter elements have evaporated into space; leaving behind a dense, ultra-hard surface of titanium and aluminum oxides that defies industrial mining.
High-energy proton bombardment mechanically chips away at atomic nuclei in the surface rock; creating a highly radioactive, chemically volatile topsoil.
The world frequently passes directly through coronal loops; temporarily embedding the entire crust in a multi-million-degree plasma bath.
Extreme temperature swings from orbital eccentricity cause rocks to expand and contract violently; loudly fracturing mountains into explosive shrapnel.
The constant gravitational bulge toward the star locks a massive, permanent mantle plume in place; anchoring a perpetual super-volcano directly under the substellar point.

cold.description: Corrosive, freezing liquids dominate the lower topographies.
Freezing winds saturated with skin-melting ammonia liquid/gas.
Core is freezing rapidly; creating massive planetary shrinkage faults.
Massive under-ice methane deposits prone to explosive release.
Acidic vapors freeze directly onto structures over the dark cycle.
Freezing cycles explode rocks from within, creating jagged shrapnel.
Cold air pools in low basins, creating liquid nitrogen traps.
Violently ejects frozen water, ammonia, or methane slurries.
Sunset triggers an immediate drop of over two hundred degrees.
Ice sheets move at hazardous speeds; crushing everything in their path.
Lakes and rivers are made of liquid natural gas.
Rivers of frozen nitrogen that flow and shift under minimal heat.
Extreme cold weather systems driven by condensing nitrogen gas.
Deceptive surfaces that look solid but behave like freezing quicksand.
Hidden oceans pressurized beneath miles of shifting, crushing ice.
Gasses freeze directly onto equipment surfaces, fouling radiator fins.
Ice evaporates directly into gas, leaving unstable, sharp spires (penitentes).
Frozen gases driven horizontally at mach speeds.
Extreme cold alters structural properties; metals and plastics shatter like glass under ordinary stress.
Atmosphere condenses directly into dry ice snowfall; burying equipment in suffocating, toxic drifts.
Weak solar heating triggers structural collapse as underground ice turns instantly to gas, swallowing surface structures.
No atmospheric protection from solar UV; cosmic radiation sterilizes the frozen, unshielded crust.
Dead planetary core offers zero geothermal energy; forcing absolute reliance on dwindling external power.
Electrostatic forces and cosmic rays fuse frozen dust into abrasive, razor-sharp crusts that destroy seals.
Deep underground pockets of hyper-saline, toxic water under immense pressure that corrode drilling equipment.
Thin, freezing atmosphere causes exposed water ice to vanish via sublimation; leaving a unstable, hollowed-out surface bedrock.
Heavy, unbreathable noble gases collect in low valleys; silently displacing oxygen and asphyxiating ground teams.
Exotic ice phases provide near-zero friction; making vehicular traction and structural anchoring impossible.
Hard rock is thoroughly bonded with crystalline ice; creating a composite material that destroys standard diamond-tipped drill bits.
Deep subsurface minerals rapidly absorb any introduction of industrial heat; expanding violently and crushing tunnels or foundations.
High-pressure underground zones harbor Ice-II or Ice-V; which destabilize into massive volume changes when drilled or exposed to surface pressure.
Sublimating gases leave behind thin, ubiquitous layers of toxic lead, arsenic, or cadmium dust across all rocky surfaces.
Frozen pyrrhotite and pyrite deposits react with moisture from human habitats; releasing sulfuric acid that rots habitats from the bedrock up.
Excavating rock faces releases pockets of unstable gas hydrates; causing sudden, explosive decompression of the rock wall.
Unoxidized metallic dusts kept stable by the deep cold will instantly ignite or explode when exposed to warm, oxygenated habitat air.
Slow chemical hydration of olivine deep in the crust causes steady volumetric swelling; triggering constant, unpredictable micro-tremors.
Frozen volcanic gases are locked solidly into the rock strata; releasing highly toxic and highly corrosive fumes whenever mined.

general.description: Fast-moving space dust ablates away hull metal during entry.
Moving sand dunes made of sharp, volcanic obsidian fragments.
Fine, sharp mineral dust that cuts through fabric seals.
Open bodies of liquid sulfurous or sulfuric acid.
Clouds of sulfuric, nitric, or hydrochloric acid.
Droplets of sulfur or oil block sunlight, creating a dark, dim winter.
Dry lake beds with a pH high enough to burn organic tissue.
Local geology contains lethal levels of systemic arsenic.
Fibrous minerals flake into the air; shredding lungs upon inhalation.
Electrical currents in the upper atmosphere fry electronics.
Atmospheric pressure drops and spikes wildly over hours.
Storms cause localized atmospheric pressure to drop rapidly.
Endless plains of black, jagged, un-walkable igneous rock.
Gas bubbles beneath the surface form fragile, hollow stone domes.
Water tables are trapped above their boiling point; explosive flash-steaming.
Colorless, odorless, toxic gas replaces usable air.
Dissolving rock forms endless, unstable sinkholes and chasms.
Rainfall consists of concentrated alkaline or acidic solutions.
Completely disorganized landscapes of random blocks, ridges, and valleys.
Orbit crosses dense debris fields; constant impact risk.
High concentrations of free ozone; breaks down plastics and rubbers.
Pockmarked terrain so dense that level ground does not exist.
Surface pressure mimics the bottom of Earth's oceans.
Severe stellar winds literally peel layers off exposed mountain peaks.
Seismic shifts squirt high-pressure liquid jets onto the surface.
High concentrations of carbon-nitrogen poisons in the low air.
Surrounded by a cloud of old planetary fragments; high orbital debris risk.
Sudden drops in surface level as underground gas pockets empty.
High carbon and pressure generate falling, solid gem shards.
Salt or ice domes burst upward through rock, destroying terrain.
Rocks store electricity; stepping on them causes lightning-like discharge.
Thunderstorms with zero rain; creating constant surface arcs.
Microscopic silica dust permeates the air; ruins mechanical bearings.
Bouldery, rugged, uneven fields surrounding massive craters.
Planet-wide dust storms that create constant lightning grids.
Unstable rock balancing acts prone to toppling from wind or steps.
Ancient landscapes stripped by wind, leaving sharp, uneven ribs.
Crust has peeled away; exposing raw planetary interior.
Centrifugal forces flatten poles; day/night cycles last minutes.
Sudden vertical drops in the middle of otherwise flat plains.
Atmospheric chemistry creates a toxic, carcinogenic fog.
Hot and cold air masses clash continuously along the terminator line.
High-energy impacts or lightning strikes have turned plains into jagged shards.
Supersonic winds drive sideways rain made of liquid/solid silicates.
Star is completely invisible due to atmospheric dust loading.
Slopes of loose rock that move continuously like a slow conveyor.
Air is rich in chlorine or fluorine; instantly destroys seals and lungs.
Rocks are plated in natural lead, zinc, or pyrite films.
Atmosphere contains gaseous lead, bismuth, or arsenic.
Deuterium-rich liquids that are highly toxic if ingested or processed.
Everything is covered in a slippery, flammable film of natural oils.
Thick, tar-like seas that trap and foul equipment.
High atmospheric hydrogen seeps into metals, making metals brittle.
Wind currents lock into permanent, self-sustaining mega-hurricanes.
Ancient impacts left deep faults prone to shifting without warning.
Jagged vertical peaks that defy standard sub-orbital flight paths.
Atmosphere interacts directly with solar wind; highly ionized surface.
Surface minerals are highly altered by long-term ion bombardment.
Winds carry heavy static potential; creates continuous lightning ground-strikes.
Treacherous, collapsing underground cave systems honeycombing the crust.
Cold, dense air drops off mountains at hurricane velocities.
Frequent meteor strikes keep the surface in a perpetual state of ruin.
Caught in gravitational debris wells; high meteoroid density.
Shifting, soft salt flats rich in highly reactive lithium metals.
Rapidly changing magnetic fields create induced currents in human suits.
Magnetic poles direct solar winds into lethal beams.
Massive, multi-kilometer high cliffs prone to sheer failure.
Dense, heavy liquid-metal vapors pool in valleys.
Thin atmosphere slows down small rocks but heats them into molten buckshot.
Optical mirages that hide sudden, fast-moving storms.
Heavy seasonal downpours of volatile, chilly liquid fuel.
Opaque petroleum-like vapors limit visibility to meters.
Atmosphere traps high-frequency solar frequencies; cooks interior spaces.
Towering plateaus with vertical walls stretching for hundreds of leagues.
High concentrations of ambient, penetrating neutron radiation.
Periodic alignment with other moons creates violent global quakes.
Upper atmosphere toxic ozone layers mix down to the surface level.
Permanent dust shroud blocks 99% of stellar light and fouls machinery.
Rocky debris thrown into the upper air by storms falls as gravel.
Liquid droplets of chemical smog rain down continuously.
Miles of loose, uniform stones that roll underfoot.
Warming triggers massive soil liquefaction and mudflows.
Regolith is highly saturated with toxic, bleaching peroxides.
Reactive soil compounds create toxic gas when disturbed.
Abundant reactive phosphorus creates toxic smoke when exposed to air.
Upper atmospheric conditions arc down into the ground as massive bolts.
Giant mantle plumes create supervolcanoes across the globe.
Ground broken into geometric frost or heat wedges that trap feet/wheels.
Swept by periodic beams of gamma and X-ray radiation.
Fine surface dust that catches fire instantly when exposed to oxygen.
Rocks glow in the dark due to extreme isotopic decay.
Erosion has left needle-thin, razor-sharp columns of stone.
Magnetic lines constantly snap and reconnect; massive energy discharges.
Dominated by methane and ammonia; aggressively strips oxygen.
Unconsolidated debris slopes prone to massive dry landslides.
Crust is rich in naturally occurring, decaying uranium isotopes.
Blinding white salt plains that reflect blinding light and corrode metals.
Ionized gasses make the sky glow with toxic radiation.
Tectonic plates are fractured into millions of grinding fragments.
Flatlands broken into millions of deep, impassable crevasses.
Gravity pulls significantly harder at the planet’s low points than its high peaks.
Plains of dust so deep and low-density that vehicles sink and drown.
Crusty, fragile chemical shelves over boiling underground pools.
Natural glass and metal deposits form jagged, un-navigable hills.
Planetary dust carries extreme negative charges; ruins circuitry.
Solar particles actively strip away weather formations violently.
Upper-level winds move at supersonic speeds.
Deep, unstable abyssal canyons miles deep with crumbling walls.
Sun heats frozen gases directly into high-pressure wind blasts.
Magma chambers directly heat shallow water aquifers.
Vents spit out toxic, yellow, choking sulfur compounds.
Plains of acidic, sulfur-rich industrial-like chemical waste.
Dense, toxic fog that eats away at camera lenses and viewports.
Continental rifts deep enough to alter local air pressure.
Gas is compressed so tightly it acts like a dissolving liquid.
Deep valleys contain air compressed past the gas-liquid boundary.
Thin crust sits directly on top of a hyper-dense, heavy metal core.
Air currents exceed the speed of sound due to planetary heat.
Thermal updrafts capable of tearing apart entering shuttles.
Miles-deep tears in the crust that cannot be bridged.
Constant low-frequency seismic vibrations destroy structural foundations.
Heat builds up in the crust with no way to radiate out.
Heat differences between hemispheres create unending global gales.
High-pressure underground gas pockets waiting for a spark.
Zero magnetosphere; surface is scoured by raw cosmic rays.
Moon wobbles erratically due to an asymmetrical parent planet.
Mountain ranges made entirely of loose, razor-sharp scree.
Cold rain hitting hot lava fields creates massive steam explosions.
Sudden, toxic geysers of buried gases pop the crust.
Sharp, elongated wind-carved rock ridges that block lateral travel.
Dehydrated minerals in the soil aggressively suck moisture out of seals.
